trades.name: MARA
trades.why: Q3 on 11-09 came with a buyback of up to $500M (about 18% of market value), $750M of bitcoin-backed loans repaid and debt down 37% this year; it rose 10.5% on a day bitcoin hit an 11-week low and with about a third of the float short. Hedged with the bitcoin fund so the bet is the company, not the coin.
trades.wrong_if: MARA announces a share sale, at-the-market use or a new convertible (for Long Ridge or otherwise), or says the buyback waits on other uses of cash; or it gives back the whole 11-10 gain against IBIT (closes under 6.64 with bitcoin flat or up) on no news.

trades.name: QNT
trades.why: Quantinuum raised its 2026 revenue guide on record bookings (11-05), added a RIKEN/SoftBank agreement on 11-10, and broke its 20-day high up 7.4% on a day every other quantum name fell and Rigetti missed after the close; it held after hours.
trades.wrong_if: QNT closes back under its 20-day high of 40.56 while SPHB is flat or up (the breakout failed on sympathy with Rigetti); or the company or Honeywell files a share sale or the underwriters waive the lockup; or the Cantor chat walks back the raised guide.
